rounds.text: Ashapura Minechem Ltd is fundamentally misunderstood through a narrow headline P/E lens while its operational efficiency and structural growth drivers significantly outpace sector benchmarks [E1, E6]. The business demonstrates elite profitability with a return on equity of 40.6% and a return on capital employed of 36.6%, crushing the sector benchmarks of -1.52% and 4.11% respectively [E9, E10, E13]. This strength is underpinned by massive fundamental expansion, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 85% and a three-year compounded profit growth of 224% [E20, E21]. Operational momentum is further reinforced by surging top-line performance, including a 16% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months and a 25% growth over three years [E16, E17]. Furthermore, management has aggressively scaled high-margin export capabilities, with bauxite exports from Guinea leaping to nearly 8 million tons from 3.5 million tons previously, while simultaneously expanding port capacity to target 20 million tons [E84, E90]. Balance sheet health actively supports this trajectory through a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.12x and borrowings reduced to Rs 56 Cr down from Rs 78 Cr a year prior [E37, E38]. Conceded: the stock trades at an elevated price-to-book ratio of 14.78x alongside high debtors of 269 days and negative institutional money flow [E2, E43, E63].

evidence.fact: Management reiterated confidence in achieving the long-term volume target of 15 million tons for FY27-FY28.
evidence.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons.

evidence.fact: Management reiterated confidence in achieving the target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.
evidence.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.

evidence.fact: Management noted that aluminium metal is currently trading at about $3,600 and is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton.
evidence.quote: As such, the metal is doing very good, aluminium metal currently is trading at about $3,600 which is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton and that will have again some positive impact on the consumption of bauxite in coming months.

evidence.fact: Management stated that the world can absorb up to 300 million tons of bauxites every year.
evidence.quote: So, you can see that there will be some, initially there will be some gap between supply and demand, and over a time they will slowly they will fill up this gap.

evidence.fact: Management noted that bauxite inventory levels in China are at an all-time low.
evidence.quote: The inventory in China at the moment is all-time low.

evidence.fact: Management plans to expand port facilities to increase volume capacity from 15 million tons to 20 million tons by the end of the year.
evidence.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

evidence.fact: The company is looking at a significant capex of roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions over the next year.
evidence.quote: We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio.

evidence.fact: The estimated investment for the BOFFA bridge in Guinea would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.
evidence.quote: Estimated investment, we do not have the exact figure as on today, but it would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.

evidence.fact: Consolidated profit margin grew by 48% during the financial year.
evidence.quote: As you are aware that we have -- our top line has grown about 105%, and our -- the profit margin has gone 48% during this year.

evidence.fact: Logistics-intensive operations faced increases in fuel prices and transportation costs that impacted margins.
evidence.quote: Given the logistics-intensive nature of our operations, increases in fuel prices and transportation costs had an impact on margins across businesses.

evidence.fact: Consolidated EBITDA for quarter three stood at INR143 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
evidence.quote: EBITDA for quarter three stood at INR143 crores, which is a growth of 8.3% quarter-on-quarter. Margin is 14.9%, which was 13.9% in quarter two.

evidence.fact: Export of bauxite from Guinea reached almost 8 million tons in the last year against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.
evidence.quote: In the last year, we have ended almost the export of 8 million tons of bauxite against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.

evidence.fact: The company is putting up a bauxite washing plant with a capacity of 20,000 tons per day.
evidence.quote: We are also putting up the bauxite washing plant with the capacity of 20,000 tons per day which will help us to use the bauxite which is currently is not a marketable quality

evidence.fact: Guinea contributed around 76% to revenue in quarter three, and India contributed 24.2%.
evidence.quote: Guinea contributed around 76% to revenue in quarter three, and India contributed 24.2%.

evidence.fact: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year subject to shareholders' approval.
evidence.quote: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year, subject to shareholders' approval, which reflects both our confidence in the business and our commitment to rewarding shareholders.

evidence.fact: Management stated that debt is close to its peak.
evidence.quote: We expect at least that the debt is close to its peak or at peak really.

evidence.fact: A 9-megawatt solar plant linked to the bleaching clay plant under the group captive model has helped lower power costs.
evidence.quote: The recent commissioning of our 9-megawatt solar plant, which is linked to this bleaching clay plant under the group captive model, has helped to lower cost and reinforce our sustainability goals.

evidence.fact: Profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix with a higher proportion of lower-margin products.
evidence.quote: Additionally, profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix, with a higher proportion of lower-margin products contributing to overall sales.

evidence.fact: Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices.
evidence.quote: Within our portfolio, the performance of our Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices, which is a key raw material used in this business.

evidence.fact: Prolonged monsoon in Guinea impacted operations and affected overall performance during the quarter.
evidence.quote: The prolonged monsoon in Guinea had impacted our operations and affecting our overall performance.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (FY27-28): The second port expansion at GSM port is expected to add capacity by the end of FY27-28.
evidence.quote: So, that is our second port, GSM port, which should also add another 50% to 60% to that port's capacity.

evidence.fact: Management commitment: The port facilities expansion to increase volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons is expected to be ready by the end of this year.
evidence.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (next few months): Management anticipates closing long-term freight arrangements with big shipping operators in the next few months.
evidence.quote: At the same time, we also are in touch with some big shipping operators to have a long-term arrangements for the freight and hopefully, we will be able to close this kind of contract in next few months.
